answer: Sponsor co-liability: every new account needs an established sponsor who locks 8 POA for 40 epochs, and each sponsor may back at most 3 live accounts. An honest newcomer ties up 8 POA; 1,000 fakes tie up 8,000 POA and need at least 334 aged sponsors, which the attacker must first grow. Splitting sponsors across many wallets fails because every sponsor is itself bonded and shares the slash. Jurors sample 5% of sponsorships monthly and mark each jade (cleared), umber (under audit) or comet (slashed, 50% of the bond burned).
